name: Moonshot: AP-scaling Calibrum projectile

mechanic: The Calibrum SpellDamage helper has a level-breakpoint base, level-breakpoint bonus-AD ratio and 1.0 AP. At level 18 its listed breakpoints nominally give 170 + 0.6 bonus AD + 1.0 AP. This experiment treats the projectile as physical and tests armor penetration despite AP scaling; the mark-consuming attack is separate. The generic Q wrapper has no usable weapon formula.
